name: auros-web
description: auros.org — static site. Astro, static output, no client framework for content pages (spec §6D).

scripts.//build: The gates run in the order that makes a failure cheap to read: the two source lints first (they need no build), then types, then the build, then the contrast audit — which MUST run last because it measures the built HTML, not the sources.
scripts.build: pnpm run lint && astro check --minimumSeverity error && astro build && pnpm run contrast
